children: Overview
UK specialist lender's H1 revenue rose 36% yr/yr, driven by AUM growth in core markets
Company posted larger operating loss, reflecting higher expenses and £14 mln impairment charge
No interim dividend declared; company strengthened capital position via share issuance and expanded funding
Outlook
Sancus says it has an encouraging new business pipeline in UK and Irish markets for H2 2026
Company plans a strategic update with full-year 2026 results, including focus and cost reduction steps
Company expects steps taken to support sustainable operating profitability
Result Drivers
AUM GROWTH - Revenue increase attributed to higher assets under management in UK and Irish businesses
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Operating loss driven by increased expenses, including strategic investments in headcount and non-recurring charges
IMPAIRMENT CHARGE - Loss before tax includes £14m non-cash impairment on Channel Islands joint venture
